items.title: Responsive application shell
items.description: React application header, primary navigation, responsive menu disclosure, skip link, and main-content layout.

items.title: Threaded comments
items.description: Threaded comments for any resource in a multi-tenant app: post and reply with a depth limit, @mentions, edit window, soft delete, paginated lists with reply previews, emoji reactions, user flags with auto-hide and moderation, with injected authorization, a PostgreSQL store and a Fetch adapter.

items.title: Common API clients
items.description: Server-only TypeScript clients for GitHub, Stripe Checkout, Resend, Supabase reads, Microsoft Graph, Google Calendar, OpenAI, Anthropic, Saleor catalog reads, and Steel sessions with explicit credentials and bounded HTTP transport.

items.title: CSV import pipeline
items.description: Server-side CSV import for apps: upload, preview with suggested column mapping, per-row validation with typed parsers and in-file duplicate checks, idempotent commit through your own save function, and a formula-safe error report, with tenant/user scoping and a Fetch Request/Response adapter.

items.title: Searchable sortable data table
items.description: Typed React table with client-side search, stable sorting, pagination, empty states, and accessible table controls.

items.title: Plan entitlements and usage credits
items.description: Server-side plan features and limits with subscription-status fallback and grace, plus an append-only usage-credit ledger with idempotent grants and debits, expiring credits, holds and optimistic concurrency.

items.title: Environment configuration
items.description: Framework-neutral TypeScript schema for environment variables that validates a caller-supplied record at startup, returns a frozen typed object, reports every problem by key without echoing values, redacts secrets, and renders .env.example text.

items.title: Health checks
items.description: Framework-neutral Fetch handlers for liveness (/healthz) and readiness (/readyz) with concurrent named checks, per-check timeouts, critical versus degraded results, redacted errors, and no-store JSON.

items.title: HTTP resilience
items.description: Runtime-neutral TypeScript retry with exponential backoff and full jitter, AbortSignal-aware timeouts, an idempotency-safe Fetch retry wrapper that honors Retry-After, and an in-process circuit breaker.

items.title: Notification inbox
items.description: Server-side in-app notification inbox (the bell menu): idempotent publish, newest-first cursor paging, unread counts, mark read, mark all read, archive and retention pruning, scoped to each user's own tenant, with injected persistence and a Fetch Request/Response adapter.

items.title: Notification preferences
items.description: A configurable preference form, validated TypeScript domain model, Fetch API client, and authenticated Request/Response adapter with injected atomic persistence.

items.title: Organization invitations
items.description: Tenant invitations for multi-tenant apps: invite by email with a role, inspect, accept once, revoke and expire, with hashed one-time tokens, injected authorization and persistence, and a Fetch Request/Response adapter.

items.title: Password reset by email link
items.description: Forgot-password flow for server apps: enumeration-safe reset requests, emailed one-time links with hashed 256-bit tokens, verify without consuming, single-use completion with a password policy, revocation of other links and sessions, a PostgreSQL store and a Fetch adapter.

items.title: Real-time presence
items.description: Who is online, viewing or typing in a room for multi-tenant server apps: join, heartbeat and leave per tab, members grouped by user, TTL expiry and sweep, small validated JSON state (cursors, typing), ordered join/update/leave events with throttled updates, and a Server-Sent Events Fetch adapter.

items.title: Public data and catalog maintenance clients
items.description: Server-only TypeScript adapters for Frankfurter, NWS, Census, vPIC, Crossref, GLEIF, ROR, Open Food Facts, Open-Meteo, deps.dev, OSV and endoflife.date with injected transport, bounded responses, conditional cache metadata and normalized errors.

items.title: Rate limit
items.description: Runtime-neutral TypeScript rate limiting with token bucket, fixed window, and exact sliding window algorithms over a pluggable atomic store, a bounded in-memory LRU store, and Fetch-standard 429 and RateLimit header helpers.

items.title: Role-based access control
items.description: Role-based access control for multi-tenant server apps: static roles with resource:action wildcards, inheritance and deny rules, tenant-wide or per-resource assignments with expiry, fail-closed checks, anti-escalation grants, last-owner protection, a PostgreSQL store and a Fetch adapter.

items.title: Security headers
items.description: Framework-neutral TypeScript builder for HTTP response security headers: validated Content-Security-Policy with per-request nonces and report-only mode, HSTS, nosniff, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy, COOP, and X-Frame-Options, applied to Fetch Responses.

items.title: Short links
items.description: URL shortener for multi-tenant apps: create short links with random or custom codes, validated destinations, expiry, disable and click limits, an atomic click counter, a redirect route and a management API, with injected authorization and persistence.

items.title: Structured logger
items.description: Framework-neutral TypeScript JSON-lines logger with levels, child bindings, deterministic key-based redaction, bounded cycle-safe serialization, error cause chains, an injectable sink and clock, and x-request-id correlation for Fetch Request objects.

items.title: Semantic theme tokens
items.description: Framework-neutral light and dark CSS variables for consistent project branding without changing feature behavior.

items.title: Validated form with submission handling
items.description: Typed React form wrapper with injected validation and submission, accessible error summaries, busy state, and duplicate-submit protection.

items.title: Webhook verification
items.description: Framework-neutral TypeScript verification of inbound webhook HMAC-SHA256 signatures over raw body bytes with Web Crypto: generic hex, GitHub, Stripe, and Standard Webhooks/Svix, with secret rotation, timestamp tolerance, and a size-capped raw body reader.
